headline: Fort Hays State complete an unbeaten conference season
dek: Fort Hays State beat Southern Nazarene to close their conference schedule with eleven wins and a draw from twelve matches for 34 points, the draw at Rogers State the only points they dropped. Harding, at the other end, have lost all ten of their conference matches with two still to play.
displaced_by: Fort Hays State's win over Southern Nazarene completed their twelve-match conference schedule unbeaten, and the standing dek's 31 points is no longer true.
